name: Bibou Vintage Kaikan 2
original_name: 美貌ヴィンテージ 壊館2
source:
Hero is approached by a beautiful woman dressed in leather. She offers one million yen for training some pets. Hero agrees since in worst case the pet would be a lion and he has enough courage to do such job for a million yen. But it turns out that the pets are women...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被一名身穿皮衣的美丽女性接触。她出价100万日元，请他训练一些“宠物”。主人公同意了，因为最坏的情况不过是狮子，而100万日元足以让他鼓起勇气接下工作。然而，所谓宠物原来是女性……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
